key_insight: A 5-qubit superconducting processor performed end-to-end training and testing of a quantum classifier for beauty- and charm-jet identification.
engineering_relevance: The study demonstrates a complete hardware-based quantum machine-learning workflow and proposes a framework for training-time evaluation and circuit optimization.
method: Use simulated LHCb jet data for beauty-versus-charm classification.
Implement a variational quantum circuit on an IQM superconducting processor at Politecnico di Torino.
Perform both training and testing on real quantum hardware.
evidence_signal: Evaluation on simulated LHCb data found that hardware-induced quantum noise did not significantly degrade classification performance, though the abstract reports no numerical metrics.
watch_item: The 5-qubit demonstration does not establish quantum advantage or resolve scaling to the hundreds of observables typical of jet identification.
paper_title: Beauty and charm jet identification with end-to-end training on a superconducting quantum processor
